subject: SumrTech hosted pricing: monthly volume + peak TPS confirmation
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Emery Jackson <emery.jackson@sumrtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + ask: hosted pricing (monthly tokens & peak TPS)

Hi Emery — great chat today, thanks for walking through the product plan. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move the Hosted pricing proposal to the next step.

Recap (took notes during the call):
- Primary use: customer support automation (bot + assisted agent flows) for SumrHelp product.
- Expected MAUs: 120k active users/month to start, growing to ~350k in 12 months.
- Typical exchange: user prompt + assistant reply + 1 follow-up, average combined tokens per session estimated ~850 tokens.
- Non-chat usage: embeddings for semantic search (about 250k vectors/week).

Items we need to finalize pricing:
1) Confirm expected monthly token volume range (low/likely/high). For proposal purposes we need a 3-tier monthly estimate (e.g., 50M / 220M / 520M tokens).
2) Peak TPS target for burst sizing. You mentioned support spikes during promos — can you confirm peak concurrent requests or peak TPS? We need the 95th percentile peak for sizing.
3) Target cost target or budget range for API spend (your target $/1M tokens figure if you have it). If you prefer a hard monthly budget range, that works too.

I attached a quick workbook (sumrtech_token_estimates_v1.xlsx) with the session math from the call — if you can validate the rows highlighted in yellow that would be ideal.

Next steps (suggested):
- Emery: confirm the monthly low/likely/high tokens and an expected 95th percentile TPS.
- Marissa: will validate billing cadence and draft a Hosted pricing band proposal once numbers are in.
- Ben: will be looped for any credit/discount asks and to prepare the initial commercial terms.

If easier, a short reply with the three bullets above is perfect. Thanks again — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Emery Jackson <emery.jackson@sumrtech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@sumrtech.com
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + ask: hosted pricing (monthly tokens & peak TPS)

Vivek — thanks for the clear recap. I've validated the attached workbook with the engineering team; below are our numbers and a couple of clarifications.

1) Monthly token estimate (low / likely / high):
- Low: 45,000,000 tokens / month (pilot, limited channels)
- Likely: 260,000,000 tokens / month (wide roll-out across web + mobile)
- High: 620,000,000 tokens / month (holiday peak + expanded automation flows)

2) Peak TPS:
- Typical baseline TPS: 35 TPS
- 95th percentile peak (short bursts during promotions): ~260 TPS sustained for ~10-20 minutes; absolute peak observed in stress tests: ~520 TPS for <1 minute.

3) Budget / target $/1M tokens:
- Finance is aiming for unit cost <= $18 per 1M tokens for the hosted API to meet their internal ROI threshold. If we can structure a blended tier that gets us near $15–18 / 1M at likely volume, that would work.

Notes:
- Embeddings: roughly 1M vectors/month (40–128 dim) — please include this in the proposal as a separate line item.
- Data residency: production traffic routes from us-west primarily; will need EU region later in Q4.

I attached our own simplified token model and a short note from legal on contract timing (SOW-outline.docx).

Happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if that helps.

Cheers,
Emery
CTO, SumrTech
emery.jackson@sumrtech.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emery Jackson <emery.jackson@sumrtech.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SumrTech hosted pricing: monthly volume + peak TPS confirmation

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Emery's numbers. Key callouts for pricing binder:
- Likely volume 260M tokens/month; high tail 620M.
- 95th pct peak ~260 TPS, absolute short peak ~520 TPS.
- Target unit economics: Finance wants <= $18 / 1M tokens; prefers blended $15–18 at likely volume.
- Embeddings: 1M vectors/month (separate line).
- Region: US primary, EU later in Q4.

Marissa — can you draft a hosted pricing band with these inputs and a suggested initial credit/discount framework for the likely vs. high tiers? Also include an option for a 3-month trial cap and automatic burst protection pricing for 95th pct TPS.

Ben — if we show them a blended $/1M at 260M that hits $16.50 with a committed monthly tier, what flexibility do we have on short-term credits for adoption? Also flag any standard SLA exceptions for the burst to EU migration.

I'll propose a 20-min sync with Emery later this week to walk the numbers once you have a draft.

Thanks — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emery Jackson <emery.jackson@sumrtech.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SumrTech hosted pricing: monthly volume + peak TPS confirmation

Thanks for the forward — quick take from the commercial side:

1) Committed tier recommendation (to hit Finance target):
- Commit 260M tokens/mo: price $16.25 / 1M tokens (blended); includes 10% onboarding credit applied over first 2 months.
- If they commit 500M tokens/mo: price $14.50 / 1M tokens (blended) + 30% discount on embeddings line.

2) Burst & SLA:
- We can cover 95th pct bursts up to 300 TPS without extra charge; above that we’ll enable an auto-burst fallback policy (route to a compatible, lower-cost variant) and charge on excess TPS at a predefined burst rate. Recommend we include an explicit protective clause in the SOW to avoid surprise overage.

3) Trial / credits:
- Offer a $50k adoption credit tied to usage (applied first month(s)) to accelerate decision — reduces effective $/1M in pilot.

Marissa — can you turn this into a simple pricing table and SOW bullets? I can review and then we set a 20-minute review with Emery to agree on a commercial path.

Emery — if that sounds reasonable, propose Wed 9/8 10:00am PT for a 20-min commercial review.

Ben
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
